::: {#exm-dead-state}
#### The dead state of the checker

In the DFA $A$ of @exm-pairs-dfa, $q_2$ is a dead state (@def-dead-state):
it is not accepting, and both of its arrows lead back to it.
Once a run (@def-run) reaches $q_2$, every later state of the run is $q_2$,
so the run ends at $q_2$ and $A$ rejects the string.
For example, $A$ rejects every string that starts with $\mathtt{aa}$, whatever comes after it.

:::
